findings.message:
Reentrancy in Private_Bank.CashOut(uint256) (../sb/0xb5e1b1ee15c6fa0e48fce100125569d430f1bd12.sol#33-46):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (../sb/0xb5e1b1ee15c6fa0e48fce100125569d430f1bd12.sol#40)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] -= _am (../sb/0xb5e1b1ee15c6fa0e48fce100125569d430f1bd12.sol#42)
	Private_Bank.balances (../sb/0xb5e1b1ee15c6fa0e48fce100125569d430f1bd12.sol#11) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- Private_Bank.CashOut(uint256) (../sb/0xb5e1b1ee15c6fa0e48fce100125569d430f1bd12.sol#33-46)
	- Private_Bank.Deposit() (../sb/0xb5e1b1ee15c6fa0e48fce100125569d430f1bd12.sol#22-31)
	- Private_Bank.balances (../sb/0xb5e1b1ee15c6fa0e48fce100125569d430f1bd12.sol#11)
findings.name: reentrancy-eth
